summary: Tested Layout Configurator features: 1) Individual wall thickness for 4 walls in Add Room dialog, 2) Auto-calculation of inner dimensions, 3) Room creation on canvas, 4) fixedHeight checkbox in asset upload dialog. All features working correctly.

features_tested.feature: Add Room Dialog with 4 wall thickness fields
features_tested.details: Dialog shows 4 separate input fields: Левая (Left), Правая (Right), Верхняя (Top), Нижняя (Bottom). Default value 4.4 cm for each wall.
Inner dimensions update automatically when wall thickness changes. Example: Outer 200×150 with walls 4.4cm each = Inner 191.2×141.2 cm
Clicking 'Добавить' creates room on canvas with outer/inner dimension labels. Toast shows: 'Комната: внешний 200×150 см, внутренний 191.2×141.2 см'

features_tested.feature: Upload asset dialog with fixedHeight checkbox
features_tested.details: Dialog shows Switch toggle 'Фиксированная высота' with description 'Для лавок и элементов, где меняется только ширина'
POST /api/layout-configurator/assets correctly handles fixedHeight=true/false parameter. Verified via pytest.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: LayoutConfiguratorPage.jsx is a large file (~4900 lines) - could benefit from splitting into smaller components
Minor: Several useEffect hooks have missing dependency warnings in console - not blocking functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout Configurator individual wall thickness feature is fully working. UI path: Login -> Panel administracyjny -> Планировки tab -> Комната button. The Add Room dialog shows 4 wall thickness fields (Левая, Правая, Верхняя, Нижняя) and auto-calculates inner dimensions. Asset upload dialog has fixedHeight checkbox for benches. Backend correctly handles fixedHeight parameter.
